content.short: The HashGuardians universe is a 2D gaming metaverse, with passive income and play to earn features.
content.description: The HashGuardians universe is a 2D gaming metaverse based on the Cardano blockchain. There are 10,000 unique HashGuardian NFT´s to collect which will be the only entry to the HashGuardians universe in the first step. Each HashGuardian is an on-chain minted NFT that is only owned by you. Different species with randomized gadgets are waiting for you. All HashGuardian owners are authorized to join upcoming pre-sales. They are also able to claim free HashCoins every month. The HashBox is the item and lootbox in the upcoming HashGuardians universe.
